label: STOPP K2
title: Antipsychotic in a person who keeps falling
statement: Antipsychotic drugs in patients with recurrent falls (may cause Parkinsonism).

source.document: O'Mahony D, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632, Appendix 1 (corrected supplementary file; NHS Somerset copy used for text, sentence-identical to the earlier parse)
source.citation: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y
source.credit: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y

plain_summary: Antipsychotics can cause stiffness and slowness like Parkinson disease, and they raise the risk of falls in someone who has already fallen more than once.

medicine_groups.name: Antipsychotics, the major tranquilliser medicines
medicine_groups.note: Prochlorperazine and metoclopramide (used for nausea) are not counted.

needs_facts.meets: two or more falls in the past 12 months, or a line that says recurrent falls

options.words: Two or more falls in the past 12 months
No falls or one fall in the past 12 months

rule_for_models: Apply this rule from age 65, return no finding below 65, and check a missing age before confirming a finding. When a Group A antipsychotic is supplied and the record explicitly confirms recurrent falls or shows two or more falls in the past 12 months, report a finding and cite the supply and falls lines. With a Group A supply, report a possible finding and name the missing falls history if the falls history is absent or recorded as unknown, or return no finding if the record shows no falls or only one fall.
cannot_be_seen: The record may show the prescribed dose, the reason for treatment and dates of falls. The indication, actual use, recent falls, stiffness or tremor may need confirmation.
ask_the_gp: Whether the antipsychotic is still needed and could be reduced or stopped, given the falls. A falls and medicines review.
